Swiss Army Bench 0.0.6: getting around.

- **The mark at the top-left goes home**, on every page and window. In the Workbench or a pop-out it brings the home
  window to the front. Alt+Home does the same.
- **Back and Forward work.** The browser's buttons, Alt+Left and a mouse's back button move between views, and a reload
  keeps the view: the home page's tabs, Settings, Connections and its forms, the blades page's catalog and editor.
  Back also closes a dialog.
- **Back buttons say where they go** ("← Connections", "← Blades"), and **breadcrumbs** show where you are past one
  level ("Catalog › Warehouse › sales › orders").
- **Window titles name the place** ("Workbench · sales.ipynb"), so browser tabs and the taskbar make sense.
- **No dead ends:** a missing table, blade or connection offers a way back.
- **Updates from the tray** also stop an editor's Swiss Army Bench tools that run from the installed copy, so Windows
  can replace its files.

Update from the tray (right-click, Update to 0.0.6), or:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
